# Nuked-OPL3 import

Pinned from [Nuked-OPL3](https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPL3/tree/765ec962e473aeb767e4cba74ffdc8f588ffbfe8)
under the retained LGPL-2.1-or-later (`LICENSE`), unchanged. `source.json`
records the hashes.

It is the simulation reference for the OPL2: `sim/opl2_tb.cpp` and the
machine bench link it, built with its defaults and run in OPL2 mode, and
compare the [opl2_fpga import](../opl2_fpga/README.md) sample for sample. No RTL,
firmware or package carries it.
